description: Option quotes by strike or expiration. Get all matching option-chain rows from the Global feed for supported stock, ETF, index, and futures underlyings. For range requests, up to 100 contracts with strikes closest to the underlying price may also include last_price, volume, open_interest, open_interest_time, change, and change_percent. Other rows retain available bid/ask, Greeks, and contract fields. Additional fields may be omitted. With no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector, range defaults to 1000. Strike takes precedence over range. → Returns {underlying_code: string, last_update: number, last_price?: number, data: [{code?: string, type: string, strike_price: number, expiration: number, ask_price?: number, bid_price?: number, delta?: number, gamma?: number, theta?: number, vega?: number, rho?: number, implied_volatility?: number, theoretical_price?: number, bid_iv?: number, ask_iv?: number, last_price?: number, volume?: number, open_interest?: number, open_interest_time?: number, change?: number, change_percent?: number}]}. Top-level last_price is the underlying price; row last_price is the option price. expiration is YYYYMMDD; open_interest_time is Unix seconds; last_update is Unix milliseconds. Extra trade/open-interest/change fields require range and an available underlying price, and are omitted with strike. data retains every matching contract, including rows without those extra fields. Search for the underlying with search_symbols; for futures, use a dated contract from get_symbol_contracts. Strike overrides range; from/to override expiration. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000. Use type and sortBy/sort to select and order rows, then filter for Greek thresholds. Use get_quotes with up to 10 returned codes for separate quote lookups or get_symbol_series for historical bars. Guide: https://insightsentry.com/docs/options.

code.description: (Required) Symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Use search_symbols to find the correct code.

expiration.description: (Optional) Exact expiration date. Validated but not used when from or to is provided. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: (Optional) Minimum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored.  (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

range.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. When that price is available, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of it. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Ignored when strike is provided. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

strike.description: (Optional) Strike price for exact match filtering.

to.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

name: get_options_quotes
